verdict.rationale: Asana's vendor docs describe AI Teammates and 'Asana Dash' (an AI Chief of Staff) that surface insights/suggestions from Work Graph data, plus AI Studio for building AI-driven workflows, indicating first-party support for AI-generated insights inside the product. However, this is all vendor-claimed marketing copy with no independent/hands-on evidence confirming these insights actually work well or are widely adopted, and community discussion is silent on AI features entirely. Missing for 10: independent verification/hands-on review of AI insights quality, concrete examples of AI-generated suggestions in use, and community corroboration.
